title: Claude Code Subagents: Run Parallel AI Workers Across Your Codebase
summary: Claude Code subagents run in isolated context windows — separate workers for research, review, and coding that never bloat your main session.
body_markdown: A subagent runs in an isolated context window — it starts fresh with no knowledge of your main session history. It returns only a summary, so the 40 files it read or the intermediate steps it took never appear in your main context. Prompting Claude directly in the main conversation exposes every intermediate step and file read to the conversation, which bloats context and narrows what the main session can do next.
